answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 39196 Country: India Title: Can I do zikr, recite durood and recite Quran verbally which I am having by heard during the state of impurity Question: Can I do zikr, recite durood and recite Quran verbally which I am having by heard during the state of impurity? Answer ID: 39196 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1169/978/B=1433) It is not lawful to recite the holy Quran in such case. Yes, you may offer tasbih, wird etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
